1.why: Every screen renders text in a clean, legible sans-serif with visibly generous letter spacing and line height, from headings down to helper text.

2.why: All content is short sentence-case strings with no italics, no all-caps styling, and no dense paragraphs anywhere in the flow.

3.why: The single-column mobile layout is clean at first, but by step_08 eight stacked duplicate error banners occupy most of the viewport and push the form below the fold, so well laid-out content does not hold throughout.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Sign in to start your security setup.' and 'Use your saved password' are brief, plain-language sentences.

5.why: The email field is accompanied by 'Example: marcus@example.com', showing exactly what the expected input should look like.

6.why: At no point must the user read a long passage; even the accumulated error banners repeat a single short sentence rather than presenting a long block of text.

7.why: No copy-to-clipboard affordance appears on any screen and the flow never advances past sign-in, so OTP and recovery codes are never presented in copyable form and the password must be typed by hand.

8.why: None of the eight screenshots shows a QR code or any equivalent alternative to manual entry.

9.why: The 'Use your saved password' hint beneath standard email and password inputs indicates password-manager and autofill support at the sign-in step.

10.why: The 'Step 1 of 4 · Sign in' header and the single full-width blue 'Sign in' button keep the current step and primary action clear, although the growing stack of error banners competes for attention.

11.why: Each screen presents exactly one primary action (the 'Sign in' button), with 'Need help?' offered only as a collapsed secondary disclosure.

12.why: After each attempt the system merely appends another identical 'Check your email and password, then try again.' banner, never plainly stating what happened or what comes next and never progressing beyond Step 1 of 4.

13.why: Retries remain possible across all eight attempts with no visible lockout, but there is no show/hide toggle, no way to re-request codes, and each retry adds another stacked banner.

14.why: The error message is blame-free and gives a fix ('check your email and password, then try again'), but it never specifies the actual problem, repeating unchanged even when the provided demo credentials are used.

15.why: No countdown, session timer, flashing, or auto-updating element appears on any screen, so no time limit is imposed on reading or entry in the observed flow.
